questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: They are the leading maritime university.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: School and teaching was in fact amazing and really challenging. Not that fund of the experience socially due to especially the age difference, as I was only allowed to take undergraduate course - also the city.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Not easy. I struggled a lot with the entire process of arrivial and the enrollment, unfortunately.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: The student hub.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: the student hub was really kind and helpfull, but i had so many unclear things and questions (due to lack on information both from the university of Copenhagen and Southampton e.g. that i was not allowed to take postgrad. courses...

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Easy, but really expensive... Also, usually the private accomodations do not do leases for less than 6 months. I made a special deal with my accommodation and paid extra

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Expensive, i would advise living down in the center, do NOT pay anything before seeing the accommodation.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: They were so expensive.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: after I had chosen my courses, the university got back to me with whether it would be possible, including whether the course would be created. once they were notified of the creation of the course, they confirmed it to me. however, at no point could they tell me what kind of final exam I would have to take. this was also not stated in the course description of the course.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: i was in direct contract with the team responsible

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: i was not. it later turned out that i was not allowed to take postgrad. courses, as they would not 'approve' me as a postgrad. student, so i could only take undergrad. courses, and i had to apply for a change of pre-credit/apprioval. i also expressed my dissatisfaction to the university, as i did not understand why they would not recognize me as a master's student. it was a bit unfortunate, as i had chosen this particular university for their offering of postgrad. courses in shipping - maybe Copenhagen University should have been aware of this.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: see above.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: it was surprisingly challenging courses. i have never learned so much in such a short time, including in the individual subjects, as i did during my stay.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: No group work, which i liked

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
Foundations of Contact law – 7,5 ECTS
International Commercial Sales – 7,5 ECTS 
Carriage of Goods by the Sea - 15 ECTS
Admiralty Law - 15 ECTS

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
see above. 

very international, which i found so great. 
contract law, because it was really interesting to lean common law
